raw.title: Data Analyst
raw.description:
**WE BELIEVE IN MAKING A DIFFERENCE THROUGH DATA AND TECHNOLOGY \- HOW ABOUT YOU?**

At Mime, our purpose is to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decisions and improve lives. We are passionate about helping our public sector, charity and other not\-for\-profit clients improve outcomes through better use of data, and we've got a new role in our friendly team for an analyst. We’re looking for a someone who can evidence exceptional analytical capability, but also who shares our passion to positively improve people’s life chances through the creative use of data.

**What you’ll be doing**

Working closely with the rest of the consulting team you will analyse data to create accessible and visually appealing insights for a range of clients with a social purpose, ranging from local authorities and multi\-academy trusts, to charities and other not\-for\-profit organisations. Contributing to a wide variety of projects, your typical responsibilities will include:

* Data analysis and visualisation for clients using a range of analysis tools, including Microsoft Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Microsoft Access and SQL
* Pulling out key findings from our analytical reports for our clients
* Manipulating and preparing data for web\-based systems including the SEND Dashboard, Intelligent London, EYFS Tracker, Applied Learning Tracker and SS Tracker, as well as helping to develop the Mime Data Hub (our core information repository)
* Statistical analysis, including regression modelling
* Research, for example interviewing stakeholders or desk research of academic papers
* Automating data processing tasks, for example through the use of APIs and Visual Basic for Applications (VBA)
* Other work on client facing projects. This will vary depending on the skills you bring, but may include report writing, design work and assistance with marketing
* Quality assuring work carried out by other members of the team to ensure that they meet Mime’s exceptional standards
* Supporting users of our analysis websites

**What we’re looking for**

We value talent and drive. As an entry or early career level role in our small organisation, we’re looking for a smart, motivated candidate with the following skills and qualities:

* An excellent level of academic attainment (First or 2:1\) within a relevant quantitative degree discipline such as mathematics, science, engineering, computing or social sciences
* Strong Microsoft Excel knowledge is an essential requirement, with experience of analytics and database tools/languages such as Tableau, Power BI, Microsoft Access, SQL or other relational databases being desirable
* Great written and verbal communication skills, not only able to make sense of large data sets themselves, but also able to convey insights to those from less technical backgrounds
* Extremely well organised, able to juggle multiple demands on your time but retaining a meticulous attention to detail
* Coding experience is advantageous (e.g., Python, R or VBA), as would be experience of applied statistics, such as significance testing
* A keen eye for design in the effective presentation of data
* Self\-motivated with the ability to pick up new ideas readily
* Ideally, you’ll have gained some work experience (perhaps an internship) within an analytical capacity, perhaps within a technical, consulting, educational or charity arena

**Who are we and why join us?**

Formed in 2007, Mime is an innovative, award\-winning consultancy. Our mission is to use our deep sector knowledge, technical and data expertise, and people\-focussed approach to deliver actionable insights that support confident decisions and improve lives. We offer a range of services including data analysis, visualisations, dashboard design, process automation, system development, social research and evaluation.

Our work has been used by thousands of organisations, and we’ve established a great reputation amongst local authorities, schools, charities and other not\-for\-profit organisations, with exceptional client retention.

Joining our friendly and supportive team, you will have genuine exposure from an early stage. As a small, progressively minded business, we truly value the contribution of all our team members, welcoming everyone’s ideas and encouraging people to take responsibility. Working for us offers a unique opportunity to support an innovative, entrepreneurial business doing work that makes a real difference to people’s lives.

This role will be predominantly based in our office at London Bridge, near iconic landmarks like the Tate Modern, the Shard, Borough Market and the Thames. We are happy to discuss flexible working arrangements \- most of the team work 1 or 2 days a week from home, although the office is open all week.

**Package:**

* Salary starting from £29,000 p.a. inc. bonus (with higher packages available for candidates with strong technical experience)
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays (you can buy or sell up to 5 days per year)
* Protected training \& development time
* Contributory pension
* Healthcare (after 1 year’s service)
* Childcare vouchers
* Paid volunteering day (annually)
* Life insurance
* Cycle to work scheme
* Discounts in local businesses (such as gym membership)
* Team social events

**How to apply** 

To apply, please submit a CV and optional cover letter, along with your answers to the application questions (see below). Please note that we can only consider applications that include responses to all three questions.

We are committed to being an inclusive employer and we welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, faith or disability. If you have particular accessibility needs, please get in touch and let us know any requirements you may have.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Graduate

Pay: From £29,000\.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Why are you interested in working at Mime and what motivates you about this role? (250 words max)
* What are some key considerations when analysing a new data set? (250 words max)
* What are some of the big issues in education? (250 words max)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London SE1

**Job Description \- Summary**  

We are AMS. We are a global total workforce solutions firm; we enable organisations to thrive in an age of constant change by building, re\-shaping, and optimising workforces. Our Contingent Workforce Solution (CWS) is one of our service offerings; we act as an extension of our clients’ recruitment team and provide professional interim and temporary resources.



AMS are looking for multiple **Junior Data Analysts** for a **6 month contract based in Cardiff/ Newcastle.** Please note that this is a hybrid working model with expected travel to the Cardiff / Newcastle office.


*Successful candidates will attend a two\-week mandatory training period in the Cardiff/Newcastle office.*

 **Purpose of the Role:**  

As a Junior Data Analyst you will have the opportunity to be part of The Analytics Support Centre. The Analytics Support Centre is a Cardiff based delivery centre developed to support engagement teams worldwide with data extraction and upload into the custom Analytics platform.



Analytics can enhance the quality and efficiency of an audit, as well as deliver meaningful insights to clients. The vision is for analytics to be used on all audits. The Analytics Support Centre supports the objective to differentiate from competitors and ensure the continued delivery of a high\-quality, distinctive client experience.

 **Responsibilities as a Junior Data Analyst;**  

* Serving as the first point of contact for engagement teams using the Analytics platform for troubleshooting or general functionality queries, providing assistance and guidance in its use.
* Supporting data acquisition and extraction from clients' accounting systems.
* Handling the manipulation and upload of complex data sets from various finance systems across multiple business areas and clients into the platform.
* Maintaining a high\-level understanding of the system being supported and using Microsoft SQL to troubleshoot issues raised by the audit practice via the help desk system.
* Potentially developing and maintaining various bespoke projects outside the analytics platform on a client\-by\-client basis.
* Conducting data quality checks, which may need to be escalated to the audit practice or client as necessary.
* Assisting relevant teams in troubleshooting platform or bespoke solution issues.

  

**Candidate Requirements;**  

* A degree with a 2\.2 or above, preferably in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a science\-related field. Other qualifications will also be considered.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel (including formulae such as SUM, COUNT, IF, VLOOKUP, ISERROR).
* Enthusiasm and demonstrated problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Previous experience working with a structured programming language such as C\#, VBA, C\+\+, or SQL is highly beneficial.
* An understanding of basic accounting principles is beneficial but not required.

  

**Next Steps:**  

This client will only accept workers operating via an Umbrella or PAYE engagement model.


**If you are interested in applying for this position and meet the criteria outlined above, please click the link to apply and we will contact you with an update in due course.**



AMS, a Recruitment Process Outsourcing Company, may in the delivery of some of its services be deemed to operate as an Employment Agency or an Employment Business

  

Job Reference: AMSCWS01171

Sporting Solutions London
**The Wow**
-----------


**Quantitative Analyst – Revolutionizing Sports Betting**


**Join our team and shape the future of sports betting!** We’re seeking a highly motivated and innovative Quantitative Analyst to develop and maintain cutting\-edge statistical models. You’ll play a crucial role in enhancing our market offerings and driving our success in the dynamic world of sports betting. This is an opportunity to leverage your expertise in data science, machine learning, and AI to build models that predict outcomes, manage risk, and unlock new possibilities in micro\-markets and derivatives.

  

**A taster of what you will be involved with:**
-----------------------------------------------


As a Quantitative Analyst, you will be a key contributor to our quantitative modelling strategy across multiple areas, including:


* **Core Sports Betting Models:** Develop and refine models for predicting match outcomes, incorporating advanced statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and AI techniques.
* **Player Statistics Models:** Build and maintain sophisticated models that analyze player performance and predict individual contributions, opening up exciting new betting markets.
* **Risk Management Models:** Design and implement robust risk models to optimize our exposure and ensure the long\-term sustainability of our operations.
* **Market Expansion:** Contribute to the development of innovative market offerings, including derivatives and micro\-markets, by creating the necessary underlying models.
* **Technology Modernization:** Collaborate on the modernization of our modeling technologies, exploring and implementing new tools and platforms to enhance efficiency and scalability.
* **Data\-Driven Innovation:** Contribute to the development of new data\-driven methodologies, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in sports betting analytics.
* **Data Collaboration:** Work closely with the data engineering team to optimize data storage and retrieval processes, ensuring seamless access to the information needed for model development.
* **Data Acquisition:** Identify and collect relevant data sources to fuel model development and improvement.
* **Knowledge Sharing:** Document model methodologies clearly and concisely, effectively communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders across the business.
* **Performance Analysis:** Collaborate with the performance analysis team to identify areas where models can be improved and contribute to the ongoing refinement of our analytical tools.
  

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------


You are a highly analytical and results\-oriented individual with a passion for sports and a deep understanding of quantitative modelling. You thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are eager to contribute to a team that is pushing the boundaries of sports betting analytics.


* **Education:** PhD, Masters, or Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering).
* **Programming Skills:** Proficiency in C\# and Python is essential.
* **Modelling Expertise:** Strong knowledge of statistical and machine learning modelling techniques.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical information to diverse audiences.
* **Industry Knowledge:** A solid understanding of the sports betting industry, sports trading, and sports modelling.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and provide clear justifications for chosen methodologies.
* **Modelling Experience:** Proven experience in building and deploying mathematical models.
* **Data Skills:** Proficient in data retrieval and statistical analysis.

**Bonus Points:**


* Experience working in the sports betting industry.
* Mentoring and team leadership skills.
* Experience developing quantitative models using machine learning and AI.
* Strong knowledge and skills in data engineering (SQL).

**What we offer**
-----------------


* A chance to be part of a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of the sports betting industry.
* The opportunity to work on challenging and impactful projects.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* A collaborative and supportive work environment.

**If you’re ready to take your quantitative skills to the next level and revolutionize the world of sports betting, we encourage you to apply!**

  

**Challenge accepted?**
-----------------------


***By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our*** ***Privacy Policy***

Sohan Kusuma

**About The Role**
 The Data Analyst role at Blue Moon Recruitment offers an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical and commercially minded professional to make a significant impact within our organization. The primary purpose of this position is to transform complex data sets into meaningful insights that drive strategic decision\-making and operational efficiency. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with various stakeholders, including senior leadership, operational teams, and technical departments, to understand business needs and deliver actionable intelligence. This role requires a proactive approach to data analysis, a strong understanding of business drivers, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to non\-technical audiences. As a key contributor to our data\-driven culture, you will support continuous improvement initiatives and help optimize our processes through innovative reporting and analytical techniques.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 To be successful in this role, candidates should possess a strong background in data analysis, statistics, and business intelligence. Proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau are essential. Candidates should have a solid understanding of statistical modeling, forecasting, and trend analysis. Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources is highly desirable. Technical skills in programming languages such as Python, R, or C\# / .NET, along with familiarity with data storage solutions like PostgreSQL, Parquet, or DuckDB, will be advantageous. A degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred. Additionally, candidates should demonstrate excellent problem\-solving abilities, strong communication skills, and a keen eye for detail.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze and interpret sales, revenue, margin, and gross profit data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that support commercial performance and strategic decision\-making.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting processes, maintaining high standards of data quality.
* Conduct detailed analysis and statistical modeling to uncover patterns, anomalies, and insights related to category performance, promotional effectiveness, seasonal trends, and market claims.
* Support budget modeling and forecasting activities by providing relevant data insights and predictive analytics.
* Perform proactive sales performance analysis to identify growth opportunities and optimize business strategies.
* Analyze private label performance across different markets to identify expansion opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Identify new business and market opportunities through comprehensive data analysis and market research.
* Develop and maintain automated reports and interactive dashboards using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools to facilitate real\-time data access and decision\-making.
* Present data insights in a clear, accessible manner to support strategic discussions and operational improvements.
* Provide insights and analysis to support wider commercial strategies, including market sizing, territory performance, and customer trends.
* Collaborate effectively with operational, commercial, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored insights.
* Translate complex data findings into concise, actionable recommendations for stakeholders at all levels.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, enhance data quality, and promote a culture of data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.


**Benefits**
 Blue Moon Recruitment offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ well\-being and professional growth. This includes competitive salary packages, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career development through ongoing training and professional development programs. Employees also enjoy health benefits, pension schemes, and a supportive work environment that encourages innovation and collaboration. We believe in recognizing and rewarding our team’s contributions, fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture where everyone feels valued and empowered to succeed.

I am thrilled to introduce myself for the Data Analyst position within your Commercial Finance Team at the Portbury National Distribution Centre. As the UK’s leading food supplier to the health and social care sectors, apetito’s mission of delivering high-quality, nutritious meals to vulnerable communities is incredibly inspiring. I am eager to bring my technical expertise in Power BI, Tableau, and Advanced Excel to your warehousing and distribution operations, helping to translate complex datasets into actionable business insights that shape strategic decisions.

During my data analytics work, I have developed a strong track record of building interactive dashboards that enable clear data storytelling. For instance, in a recent data simulation, I built Tableau dashboards to perform forensic data analysis and utilized Advanced Excel to classify data and draw critical business conclusions. Additionally, my academic and project experience includes building end-to-end data pipelines and utilizing Power BI with DAX to surface key performance indicators and regional trends. I pride myself on my ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, providing independent and thoughtful challenge to operational teams while explaining the 'why' behind the numbers to non-technical stakeholders.

I hold a valid UK driving licence and have access to my own transport, ensuring I can easily commute to your Portbury site at least 3 days per week. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my analytical background and passion for emerging AI trends can help streamline your reporting and support apetito’s journey toward Net Zero by 2040.

Warm regards,

Sohan Kusuma

* Experience in retail, QSR, or commercial/trading environments

* Experience improving reporting or building dashboards

* Building and improving **aggregator reporting packs** for internal teams and franchisees

* Analysing trends, identifying risks and explaining performance clearly
* Working with Data Engineering to improve reporting, automation and data quality
* Supporting teams with insights that guide day‑to‑day trading decisions

* The chance to shape and improve reporting in a growing area of the business

**You bring the flavour. Together, we deliver delicious.**

**Job Description:**

**Content QA Specialist**

**Location: Bristol, Onsite**

**Salary:** **£35,525** **per ann**um

**What This Role Is All About**


As a Data Analyst, you will play a crucial role in creating, distributing, and analysing key performance data to drive efficiency and support business growth. You’ll work across a variety of data sources to deliver meaningful insights, respond to ad hoc business requests, and develop reporting dashboards that enable informed decision\-making at all levels of the organisation.


The role involves analysing complex datasets and translating findings into clear, actionable insights and case studies that support operational and strategic objectives. You will also be responsible for maintaining high standards of data quality, ensuring information is accurate, reliable, and fit for purpose.


If you are able to distinguish valuable insight from noise and present data in a way that is engaging and digestible for stakeholders with varying levels of technical understanding, we would love to hear from you!

**Your Key Areas of Focus**

* Collect, process, and analyse large sets of data from various sources
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present insights effectively
* Distribute key performance data to relevant stakeholders on a regular basis
* Foster strong working relationships with the Likewize Support team
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand their data requirements

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role
* Strong proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong communication and collaboration abilities
* Attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets
* Knowledge of statistical analysis and data mining techniques is a plus

**Get To Know Us**


The world runs on connected devices. At Likewize, we make the experience around them work better. We partner with many of the world’s biggest brands to design and deliver seamless device journeys across protection, repair, upgrade, and renewal. We help our partners unlock growth by putting customer experience at the center of the entire device lifecycle. When tech goes wrong, we make it right. When customers are ready for something new, we make the transition simple. We operate on a global scale but never lose sight of the individual customer. Innovation is part of our DNA. We move fast, challenge the obvious, and look for better answers.


We are driven by Success, Passion, Professionalism, Accountability and Teamwork – and we look for people who share the same values. At Likewize, we Go for Growth. To us, that means passion over complacency, accountability over excuses, teamwork over silos, and professionalism as the standard. This is how we create success. If that fires you up, you’re going to love it here.


To learn more about who we are, visit our website at www.likewize.com.

**Where We Work**


Our Bristol office is located less than two miles from the centre of the city, making it an easy and convenient commute. Parson Street train station is just a 25‑minute walk away, and for those who prefer to drive, there’s a large free on\-site car park available.


Once you’re here, you’ll also find plenty of added perks. Our Bristol office benefits from a subsidised on\-site gym, open 24/7, with state‑of‑the‑art equipment, fitness classes, and personal training sessions available.


The office itself is a fun and vibrant space, designed to encourage creativity and fresh ideas. It features spacious meeting rooms, fully equipped desks, and multiple breakout areas. During the summer months, the outdoor terrace offers a great place to relax, enjoy the view, or challenge your colleagues to a game of ping pong.


All of this makes our Bristol office a fun, accessible, and creative place to work.

**Ensure Fairness \& Embrace Differences**


Together we are committed to creating a work environment where differences are celebrated and are essential to our success. We are a Disability Confident employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive environment for all. We actively encourage applications from individuals with disabilities and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace to ensure accessibility and equal opportunity. If you require any accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re here to help.

Established in 2004,
 
**OLIVER**

 is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in\-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40\+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.
 

  
 





 As a part of
 
**The Brandtech Group**

 , we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting\-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our
 
**AI solutions**

 enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision\-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.
 
  
 



**Data Analyst**




**Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom**





  
 





 Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact.
 

  
 





 As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients.
 

  
 





 We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London.
 

  
 




**About the Role**

  
 





 As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post\-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape.
 

  
 





 A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision\-making tool for marketing, e\-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets.
 

  
 





 Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e\-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles.
 

  
 





 You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e\-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage.
 

  
 





 This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations.
 

  
 




**What You Will Be Doing**

  
 





 Marketing \& Sales Performance Analytics 
 

  
 



* Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell\-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs.


* Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery.


* Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods.


* Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective.


* Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity.


* Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.


* Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context.



**Customer Experience \& Digital Analytics**

  
 



* Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways.


* Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities.


* Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post\-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends.


* Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post\-purchase and onboarding experience.


* Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop\-off points, and recommend enhancements.


* Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation.


* Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates.


* Reporting, Dashboards \& Stakeholder Insight


* Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e\-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity.


* Translate data into clear insights that guide decision\-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams.


* Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes.


* Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning.



**What You Need to Be Great in This Role**

  
 




**Essential**

  
 



* Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e\-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments.


* Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design.


* Hands\-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance.


* Demonstrable experience combining sell\-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight.


* Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects.


* Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels.


* Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e\-commerce KPIs.


* Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar.


* Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non\-technical audiences.


* Experience working with multi\-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions.


* A passion for data\-driven decision\-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows.



**Preferred:**

  
 



* Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting.


* Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows.


* Experience working in retail, e\-commerce or retailer media environments.


* Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources.


* Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

jobs.title: Performance Analyst
jobs.description: **Performance Analyst** **Pay up to £51,762, plus 28\.97% employer pension contributions, hybrid working, flexible hours, and great work\-life balance.** Do you want to work in a place where your dashboards, KPIs and data storytelling don't just inform decisions, but directly improve outcomes for people at the moments they need support most? This campaign covers four vacancies across three areas within DWP's Digital and Transformation Group: Communication, Collaboration and Network Services; the GOV.UK and Signposting team; and the Performance Analytics Hub. You'll work alongside product managers, designers, engineers and researchers to ensure services are built with clear success measures, meaningful KPIs and a strong understanding of user behaviour from the outset. Your role goes beyond reporting \- you'll help teams define what they are trying to achieve, understand how users move through complex journeys, and use insight to influence what happens next. The work you do will improve outcomes for citizens and strengthen digital services across all of DWP. The scale of what we do is extraordinary, and our purpose is unique. We'd love you to join us. **What skills, knowledge and experience will you need?** **Performance Measurement** Show how you've developed or shaped approaches to measuring performance. This could include defining meaningful KPIs, setting up frameworks, or translating high\-level business goals into clear, measurable outcomes. We're looking for evidence of how your work has helped track performance and drive improvements. **Communicating Analysis and Insight** Demonstrate how you communicate analysis in a clear and impactful way. Tell us how you've tailored your approach for different audiences, using the right mix of visuals, presentations or written outputs to bring your insights to life. Include examples of how your analysis has informed decisions or led to practical, actionable recommendations. **Working Together** Provide examples of how you've worked collaboratively with others. This might include building strong relationships with stakeholders, sharing knowledge across teams, or contributing to a positive and inclusive team environment. Show how you support others and help create a culture where people feel valued and respected. **User\-Centred Analysis** Show how you use both quantitative and qualitative data to understand user needs and shape your analysis. Describe how you've delivered insights or recommendations that focus on the user, and how you've worked with user researchers or other colleagues to deepen that understanding. We're also interested in how you've helped others engage with user needs, data or stories in their work. **You and your role** Performance Analysts in DWP shape how digital services are designed, measured and improved. You'll work closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure measurement is built into services from the start, helping teams understand whether what they're delivering is actually making things better for users. You'll design and maintain performance measurement frameworks, including KPIs that reflect both user needs and organisational priorities. You'll also be responsible for implementing and optimising tagging strategies to enhance visibility of service interactions and user journeys. You'll help us understand how data is being captured and used across service lines to measure performance and identify areas for improvement. You will move our teams beyond surface\-level metrics by exploring how users move through services, where friction exists and what the data is really telling us about outcomes. You will work with Google Analytics data and write SQL in Google BigQuery to bring together different data sources, create meaningful analysis, and support clear and reliable dashboards using tools like Looker Studio and Power BI. Just as importantly, you'll spend time explaining what the data means. This could be tailoring insight for different audiences or helping teams use it to inform future decisions. raw.title: Performance Analyst
raw.description:
**Performance Analyst** 




  





**Pay up to £51,762, plus 28\.97% employer pension contributions, hybrid working, flexible hours, and great work\-life balance.** 




  





 Do you want to work in a place where your dashboards, KPIs and data storytelling don't just inform decisions, but directly improve outcomes for people at the moments they need support most?
 



  





 This campaign covers four vacancies across three areas within DWP's Digital and Transformation Group: Communication, Collaboration and Network Services; the GOV.UK and Signposting team; and the Performance Analytics Hub.
 



  





 You'll work alongside product managers, designers, engineers and researchers to ensure services are built with clear success measures, meaningful KPIs and a strong understanding of user behaviour from the outset.
 



  





 Your role goes beyond reporting \- you'll help teams define what they are trying to achieve, understand how users move through complex journeys, and use insight to influence what happens next. The work you do will improve outcomes for citizens and strengthen digital services across all of DWP.
 



  





 The scale of what we do is extraordinary, and our purpose is unique. We'd love you to join us.
 



  





**What skills, knowledge and experience will you need?** 




  





**Performance Measurement** 




  





 Show how you've developed or shaped approaches to measuring performance. This could include defining meaningful KPIs, setting up frameworks, or translating high\-level business goals into clear, measurable outcomes. We're looking for evidence of how your work has helped track performance and drive improvements.
 



  





**Communicating Analysis and Insight** 




  





 Demonstrate how you communicate analysis in a clear and impactful way. Tell us how you've tailored your approach for different audiences, using the right mix of visuals, presentations or written outputs to bring your insights to life. Include examples of how your analysis has informed decisions or led to practical, actionable recommendations.
 



  





**Working Together** 




  





 Provide examples of how you've worked collaboratively with others. This might include building strong relationships with stakeholders, sharing knowledge across teams, or contributing to a positive and inclusive team environment. Show how you support others and help create a culture where people feel valued and respected.
 



  





**User\-Centred Analysis** 




  





 Show how you use both quantitative and qualitative data to understand user needs and shape your analysis. Describe how you've delivered insights or recommendations that focus on the user, and how you've worked with user researchers or other colleagues to deepen that understanding.
 



  





 We're also interested in how you've helped others engage with user needs, data or stories in their work.
 



  





**You and your role** 




  





 Performance Analysts in DWP shape how digital services are designed, measured and improved. You'll work closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure measurement is built into services from the start, helping teams understand whether what they're delivering is actually making things better for users.
 



  





 You'll design and maintain performance measurement frameworks, including KPIs that reflect both user needs and organisational priorities. You'll also be responsible for implementing and optimising tagging strategies to enhance visibility of service interactions and user journeys. You'll help us understand how data is being captured and used across service lines to measure performance and identify areas for improvement.
 



  





 You will move our teams beyond surface\-level metrics by exploring how users move through services, where friction exists and what the data is really telling us about outcomes. You will work with Google Analytics data and write SQL in Google BigQuery to bring together different data sources, create meaningful analysis, and support clear and reliable dashboards using tools like Looker Studio and Power BI.
 



  





 Just as importantly, you'll spend time explaining what the data means.
 



  





 This could be tailoring insight for different audiences or helping teams use it to inform future decisions. Your work will help colleagues change what they do in the future, using evidence to improve services and better meet user needs.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working collaboratively, is curious about how services perform end\-to\-end, and cares about using data to make a real difference.
 



  





 If you like asking "what does success really look like here?" and helping teams answer that question with evidence, then you're in the right place.
 








**Details, Wages, Perks** 




  





**Location:** 
 Your choice of Birmingham, Blackpool, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle or Sheffield.
 



  





**Hybrid working:** 
 We work a hybrid model \- some time at home and some in a hub collaborating face\-to\-face.
 



  





**Pay:** 
 Up to £51,762 (£44,447\-£46,547 base salary plus a Digital Allowance of up to £5,215, depending on your capability as assessed at interview).
 



  





**Pension:** 
 Civil Service pension with employer contributions worth 28\.97%.
 



  





**Holidays:** 
 Starting at 26 days, rising to 31 days
 **.** 
 Up to 3 extra days off per month through flexi\-time
 **.** 
 Plus all the usual public holidays.
 



  





**Additional benefits** 




  




* Flexible working, including flex\-friendly policies
* Time off for volunteering and charitable giving
* "I Can Be Me in DWP" \- supporting you to bring your authentic self to work
* Discounts and savings on shopping, days out and more
* Interest\-free loans for bikes and season tickets
* Sports and social activities
* Professional development, coaching, mentoring and career progression opportunities



  





**Our culture and recognition** 



* 2024 Diversity Employer of the Year (Computing Women in Tech Excellence Awards)
* Diverse and Inclusive Leadership (Digital Leaders Awards 2024\)
* Commended: Best Place to Work in Digital (Computing Digital Technology Leaders Awards 2025\)
* Recognised as one of the Best Public Sector Employers (Women in Tech Employer Awards 2025\)



  





**Process** 




  





 We know your time is valuable, so our process has just two stages:
 



  





**Apply** 
 : Submit your application via Civil Service Jobs (full instructions provided).
 



**Interview** 
 : A single\-stage, face\-to\-face interview.
 



  





**Click APPLY for more information and to start your application.**

I am incredibly excited about the opportunity to join Contentsquare as a Professional Services Consultant on the Strategic Consulting Track. raw.title: Clinician Workforce and MI Analyst
raw.description:
Clinician Workforce and MI Analyst


Clinical Partners is one of the UK’s leading mental health providers, and we’re growing fast. We’re looking for a talented Clinician Workforce MI Analyst to join our People Team and help shape how we use data to improve patient care, strengthen clinical outcomes, and optimise operational performance.


We’re looking for a proactive and curious Clinician Workforce \& MI Analyst to own the insight that underpins our clinician workforce. You’ll bring together fragmented data, uncover trends, and provide the analysis that drives smarter workforce planning, better utilisation and stronger operational performance.


This role goes beyond reporting you’ll interpret data, highlight risks, explain patterns and recommend clear actions. Working across multiple teams, you’ll act as a trusted analytical partner, aligning stakeholders around a consistent, evidencebased view of clinician performance and workforce needs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Analyse the full clinician lifecycle: onboarding, activation, utilisation, inactivity and reactivation
* Identify trends, risks and opportunities to improve engagement, retention and performance
* Provide dataled insight to support workforce planning, supply/demand and capacity decisions
* Highlight risks to service delivery and support mitigation planning
* Build and maintain dashboards across multiple systems (including Salesforce)
* Combine data from different sources to create a single, consistent performance view
* Move beyond reporting to provide interpretation, recommendations and clear next steps
* Improve data quality, definitions and visibility across the organisation
* Act as a central coordination point for clinicianrelated MI
* Partner with stakeholders, managing competing priorities and challenging assumptions where needed

**Requirements:**

* Experience as a Data Analyst, MI Analyst or similar
* Strong analytical skills and experience with large, complex datasets
* Proficiency in SQL/SOQL and data visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau, Salesforce Analytics)
* Ability to interpret data, identify trends and generate actionable insight
* Experience combining data from multiple systems, ideally including CRM platforms
* Strong communication skills able to translate complex data into clear, concise messages
* Confident stakeholder management with the ability to influence and challenge constructively
* Curious, proactive and comfortable working in ambiguity
* Experience with workforce, operational or performance data
* Healthcare background desirable but not essential

**Remuneration and Benefits:**

* £50,000 annual salary
* 25 days paid holiday (increasing with service to 28 days) plus bank holidays.
* A day off for your birthday.
* Healthcare Cash Plan
* Benefits Platform
* Life Assurance
* Discount Vouchers
* Flexible working opportunities to suit your personal needs
* Opportunities to take part in charitable events
* Access to a Wellbeing portal and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

**Equal Opportunities Employer:**


At Clinical Partners we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed, regardless of their background, race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and strive to provide a supportive and respectful environment for all employees.

**DBS Check Requirement:**


Please note that this position requires a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check as part of our commitment to safeguarding and ensuring the safety of our clients and staff. The successful candidate will be required to undergo a DBS check before commencing employment.

raw.title: Digital Analyst
raw.description:
Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.
   

  





**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.** 
  

  





 We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.
   

  





 Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L\&G to do what they do best.
   

  





 Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We’re looking for a talented and data\-driven Digital Analyst specialising in Insights to join our Optimisation and Analytics team within Partnerships. If you’re passionate about uncovering insights from data and want to shape exceptional customer outcomes through optimisation initiatives, this is your opportunity to have meaningful impact.
   

  





 In this role, you’ll leverage data to generate valuable insight while applying strong problem\-solving skills to identify high\-impact opportunities. You’ll work with teams across the business to deliver customer\-centric improvements to digital journeys, helping to drive measurable improvements in performance and user experience.
   

  






 What you’ll be doing:
   

  





* Delivering insight deep dives and data\-driven recommendations to improving key business KPIs
* Supporting the full lifecycle of insight projects from initial requirements through to delivery, managing stakeholders throughout
* Producing dashboards, reports, and ad hoc analysis while ensuring consistent, robust, and efficient measurement approaches
* Supporting trading forums with performance insight and relevant updates
* Investigating digital performance issues and supporting resolution activities to minimising customer and commercial risk
* Identifying opportunities to improving customer outcomes in line with Consumer Duty standards
* Supporting A/B testing and experimentation to ensuring maximum insight is gained from all activity
* Developing in\-depth knowledge of the digital estate, customer journeys, and measurement strategy to informing recommendations




 Who we’re looking for:
   

  





* Strong knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics or Google Analytics
* Experience working with A/B testing and experimentation tools and applying statistical thinking (e.g. Adobe Target, Oracle Maxymiser, Optimisely, VWO)
* Knowledge of session replay, heatmaps, and dform analytics (Glassbox, SessionCam, HotJar, Decibel, FullStory)
* Familiarity with customer feedback and usability testing tools and approaches (Qualtrics, Qualaroo, Usabilla, UserTesting, UserZoom)
* Some experience with Python or similar for data manipulation would be advantageous
* Understanding of web technologies including tag management, data layers, and content management systems
* Strong communication and data visualisation skills, with the ability to present insight clearly to a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative approach, with strong relationship\-building skills and the confidence to act as a subject matter expert in digital analytics




 Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:
   

  





* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


**Additional Information**

 At L\&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.
   

  





 If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.
   

  





 We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part\-time, term\-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.
   

  





 It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

**About AXA**
 AXA is a global leader in insurance and financial services, dedicated to helping customers protect what matters most to them. As the sixth\-largest insurance company in the world, we provide a wide range of services, including health, car, home, and business insurance. We support millions of customers worldwide, helping them navigate life's uncertainties with confidence.
   

  

 AXA Commercial protects businesses, from multinationals to micro start\-ups, giving them the confidence to thrive.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Are you passionate about turning big data into actionable insights? Join our Commercial Pricing Data Team at AXA, where you’ll play a key role in shaping our strategic data landscape. Working closely with colleagues across different teams, you’ll help build a robust, insightful, and accessible data environment that empowers our Pricing Analysts to make informed decisions. If you’re eager to make a real impact through data and enjoy collaborative, innovative work, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work with a variety of data tools and databases to design solutions, as well as maintaining, creating, updating, reading, and deleting data as needed.
* Collect data from multiple sources, handling raw data, cleansing it, and converting it into structured formats suitable for further analysis and data science activities.
* Develop and maintain a business glossary and data dictionaries, and classifying data in accordance with local priorities.
* Collaborate with Data Architects, Data Protection Officers, and other stakeholders to implement data\-by\-design processes.
* Build expertise and capacity within the pricing team to enable self\-service access to data from the data lake in the most efficient way.
* Create dynamic reports within Unity Catalog and Power BI.
* Eliminate outdated reports and processes and respond swiftly to provide the right data with ease, thereby supporting better pricing decisions and helping us stay ahead as a market leader.


 At AXA we work smart, empowering our people to balance their time between home and the office in a way that works best for them, their team and our customers. You'll work at least two days a week (40%) away from home, moving to three days a week (60%) in the future. Away from home means attending the office, visiting clients or attending industry events.
   

  

**Your Skills \& Experience**
* Proficient in Python with experience using PySpark, DevOps, and Unity Catalog.
* Demonstrated skills in extracting, manipulating, and reconciling big data sets.
* Ability to work across structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, extracting insights and identifying connections between disparate data sets.
* Solid understanding of information security principles to ensure data is handled and managed in a compliant manner.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex solutions to diverse audiences.
* Understanding of the Commercial Insurance sector would be advantageous.
* Familiarity with Acturis would be advantageous.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start\-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever\-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground\-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser\-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end\-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H\&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight\-knit team is made up of ex\-Revolut, DeepMind, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate\-tech, logistics and mobility including **Planet A Ventures**, **Maersk Growth**, **Pale Blue Dot VC**, **Eka Ventures**, **NordicNinja VC** and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. #### **Role overview** We're looking for a sharp, business\-savvy Staff Data Analyst to drive business outcomes through impactful analytics within our Driver Squad. Our ideal future colleague cares deeply about creating business impact, translating business context and complex analytics into actionable insights and collaborating fluidly across teams Product, Tech, Data as well as Operations and Finance stakeholders. ###### **Team structure** We believe in opinionated analytics and creating an edge through intelligent use of technology and data in an industry that has been stuck in its ways for too long \- for better or worse. That’s why we empower our growing team of engineers, data and product folks by embedding them in domain\-centered, cross\-functional squads for meaningful business context. They take initiative for impactful projects from day one. We hone our craft and grow our skills as data professionals through functional reporting lines and regular catch\-ups and knowledge sharing sessions across the Data and wider “HIVEDmind” organisation (\= Tech \+ Data \+ Product \+ AI\&Automations). ###### **Day\-to\-day activities** In your day\-to\-day you will come up with innovative solutions to business problems and identify new (product) opportunities using data analytics. You will define meaningful KPIs and metrics and capture them in data models and reports. Being embedded in the Driver Squad, you will work closely with your team mates across Tech and Product to deliver performance and efficiency insights and inform the squad’s roadmap. You will also collaborate deeply with stakeholders beyond your squad to find efficiency gains and opportunities in our data and processes. ###### **How you create impact** The Driver Squad’s mission is to create the industry’s leading delivery operation, identifying and incentivising the best delivery performance across both cost efficiency and delivery quality. You will be leading the squad’s work across Driver Pay, Driver Performance and Incentivisation analytics, identifying opportunities for technological innovation all the way through to internal performance and process improvements. ###### **Line management** While this role is focussed mostly on individual contributions, you will also take line management responsibility for 1\-2 Analytics (Engineering) professionals within your team. This role reports directly into the VP Data. #### **Responsibilities** * Uncover business and product opportunities through robust analytics in a highly complex domain, translating technical insights with clarity for any audience. * Shape data\-driven decision\-making across your squad and the wider operation; develop actionable performance metrics that move the needle. * Size and measure the impact of ongoing initiatives and innovations. * Build powerful data models and products that deliver actionable insights to your teammates. * Line\-manage 1\-2 Analytics (Engineering) professionals: empower them through clear feedback, meaningful coaching, and leading by example. * Raise the bar: role\-model analytical rigour and smart pragmatism to shape analytics excellence across the company. #### **Your profile** * 5\+ years of experience in a similar analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence or data science role. * Experience line managing or mentoring other data professionals. * A passion for clean, efficient and meaningful SQL queries and Python notebooks. * Previous experience using modern BI tools (we use Looker \+ LookML). * AI\-savvy to scale yourself and your impact. * Deeply outcome\-focussed with an analytical mind and the necessary pragmatism to balance rigour with speed. * A high\-energy and bold communicator who enjoys collaborating across teams from different functions. #### **Technologies we use** * Analytics: Looker, Data Studio, Python notebooks and geospatial analytics tools * Programming languages: Python, SQL * Data transformation and data quality: dbt, pandas/ polars, data\-diff, Elementary * Core data platform: Dagster, dlt and Airbyte, BigQuery, Lakehouse for Iceberg (read about our platform here) * Infrastructure: Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Terraform #### **Our interviewing process** * Intro call * SQL live coding task (real, anonymised data in a SQL editor) * Analytics take\-home task and review * On\-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture) #### **Our values** * **We Are Kind** \- Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" \- it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. * **We Are Tenacious** \- We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. * **We Are Curious** \- We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not. * **We Are Resourceful** \- Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have. #### **How we reward our team** * Dynamic hybrid working environment with a diverse and driven team * Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role * 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays * 1 Birthday Day Off \+ 2 Tenure\-Based Additional Days Off * Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision \& mental health therapy * Bi\-annual performance reviews and tailored development plans * Competitive salary \+ EMI options scheme * Annual compensation review * Team lunch provided once a week * Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics) * Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right * Community volunteer days * Cycle to work scheme * Dog friendly office and depots * MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference) #### **Want to learn more?** * Meet the team in 60 seconds: **Behind the scenes with HIVED** * HIVED is **B Corporation certified** * HIVED is **\#7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100** * Read how **HIVED raised $42M** to transform parcel delivery with AI and all\-electric logistics network * Check the **Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025** * Keep up with HIVED **here**

**Mott MacDonald**

  

We’re a global engineering, management, and development consultancy.  

Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

  

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.

  

We are proud to be a one of Glassdoor’s top employers to work for in the UK, as well as being recognised as a Top Inclusive Company in the UK.

  

Our values: **P**rogress, **R**espect, **I**ntegrity, **D**rive, **E**xcellence.

  

Do you want to work for a company whose purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes, and to transform businesses, communities, and opportunities for its employees?

  

As Senior Quantity Surveyor you will be supporting the team within Water and Environment, delivering complex infrastructure schemes.

 **What you will contribute to the team;**

* Support Water Companies in delivering large capital programmes, providing an essential service, and improving the environment.
* Provide commercial support to a large project or programme of works
* Ensuring robust estimates are provided that are aligned to scope and makes due allowance for all risks and opportunities
* Managing commercial inputs to the procurement process including ensuring that strategies are developed and agreed.
* Contracts are properly managed in accordance with contract requirements including compliance with all responses to communications, payments, programme submissions etc
* Ensuring robust cost management is undertaken at all times.
* Proactive management of project and programme risk including ensuring that mitigation plans are in place and implemented.
* Development of strong client relationships across its organisation
* Monitor that technical solutions meet with technical standards, legal obligations, and client requirements.
* Use a systematic approach to critically examine the situation from different perspective.
* Gather relevant information from different sources in reaching a decision.
* Generate and weigh the different options in arriving at decisions.
* Weigh the risks and consequences of all options.
* Make well\-reasoned, sound and timely decisions based on the needs of the situation, the clients and the team member
* Involve and consult those affected by the decision.
* Maintain and build on existing client relationships to anticipate needs.

 **Required for the position of Senior Quantity Surveyor;**

* Chartered Surveyor, ideally MRICS, with a degree or equivalent in Quantity Surveying
* Experience working with NEC Contracts and other target cost, or cost reimbursable contracts
* Experienced in delivering commercial and contractual elements of heavy infrastructure projects.
* Experienced in Contract Management
* Demonstrated background working within Consultancy or Main Contracting environment
* Ability to prioritise and able to work under pressure.
* Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with clients and colleagues.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Ability to demonstrate a flexible approach to work
* Technically and commercially aware able to deliver on all post contract service delivery and to solve problems
* Proactive and self motivated
* Strong commercial knowledge
* Effective time management \- efficient and adding value to projects
* Customer focus \- ability to engage in sound relationships with the customer project team

 **Preferred, but not essential.**

* A knowledge and expertise in the water/wastewater industry sector

  

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

 **About the business unit**  

The Advisory and Programme Delivery (APD) unit delivers management services in all the sectors that Mott MacDonald operate in the Built Environment, Defence, Energy, Water, Transportation and, Education, Health and Care.


The Unit delivers services to projects ranging in scale and complexity up to £20bn, through the technical disciplines of Programme Management, Project Management, Project Controls, Scheduling, Cost Management, Estimating, Infrastructure Finance, Management Consulting, Digital Consulting and Education, Health and Care Management.


Our environment and water portfolio is primarily a UK based business delivering project, programme and commercial management services to regulated water/wastewater clients and the Environment Agency. Our work stretches across the entire project lifecycle, from pre\-contract cost estimating and benchmarking to post contract QS services and commercial assurance. For project and programme management we deliver capital projects on behalf of our clients, both internal and external that range from several hundred thousand pounds in value to major projects and programmes worth over £0\.5billion. Additionally we are the home of the cost intelligence service, a specialist team of data analysts and economists who provide expert advice across all sectors on inflation and indexation. We currently work with around half of the UK’s regulated water and wastewater companies.

  

\#LI\-DJ1


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

 **Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute.

 **Accessibility**

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

 **Agile working**


Happy to talk Flexible Working and how we can support your responsibilities beyond the workplace.

 **We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

 **Health and wellbeing**

* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.

**Financial wellbeing**

* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.

**Lifestyle**

* A minimum of 33\-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
* Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high\-street retailers.


**Enhanced family and carers leave**

* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
* Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.


**Learning and development**

* Primary annual professional institution subscription.
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**

* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.
